title: JSON layer operations
description: The public functions of the JSON layer, re-exported at the crate root. Each takes UTV JSON as serde_json::Value and answers a UtvResult named after the contract operation (validate for the validators); bad input is answered with a status, never by an error type or a panic. All are queries. The builders in utv::build only assemble values and are left out.

entities.name: Validate UTV JSON structurally
entities.description: Parses JSON text strictly and checks the envelope and the structural schema for the value's kind.
entities.transport: exported function utv::validate_structural(text); validate_value(&json) for parsed JSON
failures: invalid (duplicate-key): an object repeats a key.
invalid (syntax): the text is not JSON.

invalid (malformed-value with envelope.not-object, envelope.schema, envelope.unknown-property, envelope.kind or envelope.value): the envelope is wrong, including a malformed version label such as utv/4.
unsupported (envelope.unsupported-version): a well-formed utv/M.N other than utv/1.0.
invalid (malformed-value with one structural.schema diagnostic per schema violation).
unsupported (structural.no-schema): a core kind the schema has no definition for.

entities.name: Check a civil value against the Gregorian calendar
entities.description: Structural validation, then whether the month and day exist.
failures: Every failure of validate_structural, first.
unsupported (unsupported-operand): not a civil value.
unsupported (unsupported-calendar): not the proleptic Gregorian calendar.
unsupported (implementation-limit): a year beyond i128.
invalid (month-out-of-range).
invalid (day-out-of-range): the day doesn't exist in that month.

entities.name: Parse ISO 8601 text
entities.description: ISO 8601 extended format and RFC 3339 / RFC 9557 text to a UTV value: date, year-month, time, unzoned or fixed-offset or zoned date-time, or an instant for Z and -00:00.
entities.result: unique with the value, operation parseIso.
failures: invalid (syntax): outside the grammar (lower-case t or z, a space for T, more than nine fraction digits, year -0, a malformed annotation).
invalid (month-out-of-range, day-out-of-range, field-out-of-range, offset-out-of-range).
unsupported (leap-second): second 60.
unsupported (end-of-day): 24:00.
unsupported (unsupported-form): year only, week and ordinal dates, basic format, comma fractions.
unsupported (unsupported-annotation): Z or -00:00 followed by [zone], a critical [!...] annotation, or anything but one [Area/Location].
unsupported (implementation-limit): a year beyond i128.

entities.name: Format as ISO 8601 text
entities.description: The inverse of parse_iso; instants print as UTC with seconds.
entities.result: unique with a JSON string, operation formatIso.
failures: unsupported (no-text-form): an instant whose fraction has no finite decimal, or an offset with seconds.
unsupported (unsupported-operand): another kind, or a zone type other than iana, fixed-offset or floating.
The readers' refusals: invalid (day-out-of-range, ...), unsupported (unsupported-calendar, leap-second, ...).
invalid (malformed-value, then envelope.* or structural.schema): the value is not well-formed UTV JSON.

entities.name: Parse the text form
entities.description: Points as parse_iso, ISO 8601 periods, bracket intervals and EDTF slash intervals.
entities.result: unique with the value, operation parseText.
failures: Every refusal of parse_iso for a point.
invalid (syntax): a malformed period or interval, or .. or ? on a closed bracket.
unsupported (unsupported-form): decimal period components, EDTF qualifiers (1347~, 134X), an interval without a point.
invalid (kind-mismatch): endpoints of different kinds, forms or zone types.
invalid (reversed-interval): the end comes before the start.
unsupported (implementation-limit): a period component beyond i128.

entities.name: Format as the text form
entities.description: The inverse of parse_text, defined only where it is lossless.
entities.result: unique with a JSON string, operation formatText.
failures: unsupported (no-text-form): exact second counts, a period with mixed signs, a start-amount interval, an interval without a point or whose domain the text can't tell, another kind, or extra properties such as provenance or resolutionPolicy.
Every refusal of format_iso for a point.
invalid (malformed-value, then envelope.* or structural.schema): the value is not well-formed UTV JSON.

entities.name: Derive calendar fields
entities.description: Day of week (Monday = 1), day of year, ISO week and week-year, days in month and leap year of a date or date-time.
entities.result: unique with a JSON object of the fields, operation fields.
failures: unsupported (unsupported-operand): a time, a year-month or another kind.
unsupported (unsupported-calendar).
invalid (day-out-of-range and the other field codes): a date that doesn't exist.
invalid (malformed-value, then envelope.* or structural.schema): the value is not well-formed UTV JSON.

entities.name: Add an amount
entities.description: Calendar amounts to civil values (years and months, then weeks and days, then wall-clock time); POSIX seconds to instants, exactly.
entities.transport: exported function utv::add(&value, &amount, policy: Option<&Value>), policy {"monthEnd": "reject" | "constrain"}
entities.result: unique with the new value, operation add; zone and zone intent kept; an offsetAssertion dropped with the info code offset-assertion-dropped.
failures: none (month-end): the day doesn't exist in the target month and the policy is reject (the default).
invalid (kind-mismatch): time components on a date; weeks, days or time on a year-month; a calendar amount on an instant; something that is not an amount.
unsupported (unsupported-operand): a time of day; a non-calendar amount on a civil value; an unknown amount basis or component.
unsupported (needs-leap-seconds): SI (elapsed) seconds on a POSIX instant.
unsupported (unsupported-policy): a monthEnd value other than reject or constrain.
unsupported (unsupported-form): a decimal component.
unsupported (implementation-limit): beyond i128.

entities.name: Compare two values
entities.description: Orders unzoned civil values of one form by their fields, instants numerically and fixed-offset date-times by the instants they denote.
failures: unsupported (needs-zone-rules): either value has a named zone; resolve first.
unsupported (unsupported-operand): different kinds, forms or zone kinds.
invalid: an operand that is not a valid value, such as 30 February.

entities.name: Count days between dates
entities.description: b − a in days, for two dates that are unzoned or in the same zone.
entities.result: unique with a JSON integer, operation daysBetween.
failures: unsupported (different-zones): the dates are in different zones, or zoned and unzoned.
unsupported (unsupported-operand): not a date.
unsupported (implementation-limit): beyond i64.

entities.name: Measure POSIX seconds between instants
entities.description: b − a as an exact, reduced posixSeconds amount.
entities.result: unique with the amount, operation posixSecondsBetween.
failures: unsupported (unsupported-operand): not a POSIX instant.
unsupported (implementation-limit): beyond i128.

entities.name: Ask whether an interval contains a point
entities.description: Three-valued containment for date intervals with dates and instant intervals with instants.
failures: unsupported (unsupported-operand): a point of the wrong domain, another domain, or a construction other than start-end.
unsupported (different-zones): the dates don't share a zone.

entities.name: Ask whether two intervals overlap
entities.description: Three-valued overlap; date intervals are normalized to half-open first, and a provably empty interval overlaps nothing.
failures: unsupported (unsupported-operand): intervals of different domains, or points of the wrong kind.
unsupported (different-zones): the dates don't share a zone.

entities.name: Resolve a civil date-time to instants
entities.description: A wall time to its instant(s) under explicit zone rules and a gap and overlap policy (the argument, else the value's resolutionPolicy, else reject/reject).
entities.result: unique with the instant (with an info gap note under shift-forward-by-gap), or multiple with both instants of an overlap; operation resolve.
failures: symbolic (no-zone, info): an unzoned date-time; there is nothing to resolve against yet.
none (gap): the wall time is skipped, under reject or preserve-unresolved.
multiple with the warning ambiguous: an overlap under reject.
invalid (offset-mismatch): an asserted offset matches no candidate (including in a gap), or contradicts a fixed offset.
unsupported (unknown-zone), unsupported (outside-rule-window): the zone or the time is not covered; nothing is extrapolated.
unsupported (unsupported-policy): a gap or overlap value not listed in the contract.
unsupported (unsupported-operand): another form, or a zone type other than iana, fixed-offset or floating.
unsupported (leap-second): second 60.
error (gap): no forward transition explains a gap (offset_before_gap).

entities.name: See an instant in a named zone
entities.description: The civil date-time of an instant in a zone, with offsetAssertion set to the offset in force.
entities.result: unique with the zoned date-time, operation toZone.
failures: unsupported (unknown-zone).
unsupported (outside-rule-window): the instant is outside validFrom ≤ t < validUntil.
unsupported (unsupported-operand): not a POSIX instant.
unsupported (implementation-limit): a fraction finer than a nanosecond.

entities.name: See an instant at a fixed offset
entities.description: The civil date-time of an instant at a fixed offset; no rules needed.
entities.result: unique with the fixed-offset date-time, operation toOffset.
failures: invalid (offset-out-of-range): beyond ±18:00.
unsupported (implementation-limit): a fraction finer than a nanosecond.

entities.name: Load a zone rule bundle
entities.description: Reads a rule bundle in the format of conformance/rules/demo-zones.json from a file the caller names, from text, or from parsed JSON.
entities.transport: associated functions Rules::load(path) (also ZoneRules::load), Rules::parse(text), Rules::from_json(&json)
failures: load: Err(Diagnostics) with malformed-value, operation convert, when the file can't be read or isn't a bundle.

parse and from_json: Err(String) naming the problem: not JSON or a repeated key, zones not an object, transitions not strictly ascending, an offset that isn't whole seconds within ±26 hours, validFrom or validUntil missing.
